== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]
* Fine [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|bread crumbs]]
* 4–5 [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], peeled, cored, and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|Nutmeg]]
* [[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]]

== Procedure ==

#Butter a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]], and sprinkle with the breadcrumbs.
#Combine the apples, a little butter, nutmeg, and sugar in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Cook until softened.
#Transfer the apples into the prepared dish.
#Top apples with another layer of the crumbs, then add pieces of fresh butter on the top.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a slow [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for about 15 minutes, until it becomes a delicate brown.
#Serve hot or cold.
